fonts.display: 'Crimson Pro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Azeret Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Warm Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, and nav background — the base layer everything sits on

palette.name: Deep Ink
palette.role: Primary text, body copy, nav links, and dominant border color — the structural voice

palette.name: Press Black
palette.role: Heading text and heavy borders — slightly softer than pure black for large display sizes

palette.name: Charcoal Trace
palette.role: Secondary borders, dividers, and muted text on dark surfaces

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Helper text, disabled states, and hairline borders on light surfaces

palette.name: Dusty Mauve
palette.role: Accent panel backgrounds, heading color, and chromatic border — a near-gray purple that signals brand moments without shouting

palette.name: Pale Sage
palette.role: Secondary heading tint and accent border — a near-gray green that appears as quiet punctuation alongside the mauve
